manifest.public_data: Aggregate metrics only; no raw texts, responses, or row-level predictions.
manifest.scoring: Equal-task mean F1. Binary positive-class F1; multi-binary mean positive-class F1; categorical headline macro F1 over declared classes present in the gold sample of the task (classes with no gold item are left out). Malformed decisions and requests the provider failed are incorrect. Undefined MCC is null.
manifest.uncertainty: 95% percentile intervals; paired item resampling within each fixed task versus resampling tasks. Not simultaneous intervals.
